intent: Clear every over-cap markdown file in the repo, splitting what is still reference and deleting what is a record of finished work.
scope: Split: .github/skills/test-driven-development/SKILL.md (384 -> 135) and code-review-and-quality/SKILL.md (358 -> 123), detail into references/
Deleted: docs/cleanup-2026-05/ (7 files, 1524 lines) and linux_configuration/docs/VERIFICATION.md (261)
Non-goal: no prose rewritten or condensed
changes: Eight files split into per-topic subdirectories, each original left as a short index linking to its parts. Both SKILL.md files keep their frontmatter and description so skill discovery is unaffected; only the detail sections moved to references/.

docs/cleanup-2026-05/ deleted on the user's explicit instruction. Its seven files are status reports of a finished 2026-05 cleanup ('What Was Delivered', 'After Your Changes'), nothing references them, and the rules they describe are now enforced by the no-polling-antipatterns, shellcheck and shfmt hooks and documented in the efficient-polling-scripts skill. The only forward-looking content was a speculative 'Backlog / Future Work' list never actioned in fifteen months.

linux_configuration/docs/VERIFICATION.md deleted as the same class: an unreferenced '✅ Implementation: COMPLETE' checklist of work already done. Applied the user's ruling consistently rather than splitting a file of identical character.
PACMAN_WRAPPER_SECURITY.md was split rather than deleted - unlike VERIFICATION.md it documents live security guarantees and is genuine reference.

verification.evidence: No output. Every markdown file in the repo is now under the cap, down from twelve violations.

verification.command: diff <(git show HEAD:<file> | grep -vE '^\s*$' | sort) <(cat <the parts> | grep -vE '^\s*$' | sort) | grep -c '^<'
verification.evidence: 0 lines lost for both SKILL.md splits, checked explicitly. The two largest splits were verified by md5 of their sorted non-blank lines: a6c0f601 for SECURITY_HARDENING_ANALYSIS and b5b03a5e for the phone-focus spec, identical on both sides.

No hits outside append-only evidence and contract artifacts, so the deletions leave no dangling link. copilot-instructions.md references SECURITY_HARDENING_ANALYSIS.md, which was split rather than deleted and still resolves.
Clean, including prettier and the markdown hooks.

risks: Deleting 1785 lines is the least reversible change in this whole effort. It rests on the user's explicit instruction plus three checks: nothing references the files, their rules are hook-enforced, and their content is status reporting rather than reference. Git history retains them.

The SKILL.md files are now split across SKILL.md and references/. If the skill loader only reads SKILL.md, the detail is no longer auto-loaded - it is linked, not inlined. That is the documented references/ pattern, but it does change what an agent sees without following a link.
rollback: git revert the commit; the eight splits recombine and both deleted paths return.
After rollback, re-run check_file_length.sh and expect twelve markdown violations again.
